evidence: Petr. 135.2: partem legūminis super mēnsam effūdit
terms.comment: Of solid things too, tipped out of a container: rings, beans, sand.

phrases.latin: effundī in vestibulō cūriae jussit ānulōs aureōs
phrases.english: he had the gold rings tipped out in the entrance of the senate house

phrases.latin: partem legūminis super mēnsam effūdit jussitque mē dīligenter pūrgāre
phrases.english: she tipped some of the beans out on the table and told me to pick them over carefully

sources: Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-livius, loci-petronius), checked against the editions named there.
